summary: The runtime kit was built, qualified with stand-ins, armed and dry-run for all 18 sessions. Its one real Smoke editor exited 0 and its Python driver passed 31/31 bindings, but the cleanup reader required the wrong probe row schema and stopped all 17 remaining legs. The raw probe has one skipped world_cleanup row and one probe_stop. A respawned crash monitor is also absent from the retained owned-process list. No protected change, crash or upload evidence was found; all A3/A5/A6/A7/A8 runtime claims remain unproved.

gaps.detail: runtime_readers.clean_exit expects world_snapshot_skipped/cleanup, but the bound probe emits world_cleanup/actor_snapshot=skipped; the stand-in and synthetic reader tests copied the wrong schema.

CrashClient.log records -RespawnedInstance -MONITOR=2344 and normal exit; the owned-process receipt contains only editor 2344, UBT 13868 and conhost 39276. Descendant lifetime coverage for the crash monitor is not proven.
